Dedicated coordinator nodes have the following requirements and limitations.
• Dedicated coordinator nodes are supported in all OpenSearch versions and Elasticsearch versions
6.8 to 7.10.
• To enable dedicated coordinator nodes, your domain must have dedicated master nodes
enabled. For more information, see the section called “Dedicated master nodes”.
• Provisioning dedicated coordinator nodes can incur additional costs. However, the improved
resource eﬃciency and enhanced performance justify the investment, particularly for large or
complex clusters.
